profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I find ways to understand concepts effectively, while also being able to express my understanding to others.

positions.title: Senior Instructor
positions.description:
* Built features on App Academy’s “progress tracker” website to enhance the user experience using TDD
* Created custom controller actions in Rails backend to handle feature requests for “progress tracker” website
* Practiced standard git workflows to review and contribute pull requests to “progress tracker” website
* Wrote various tests for both backend and frontend functionality using DSL’s (Domain Specific Languages) such as Jest, Capybara,
Mocha, and RSpec
* Led the San Francisco branch in project managing curriculum Jira issues
* Enhanced student learning experience through creation of instructional videos and challenging project assignments
* Lectured on topics: Ruby on Rails, Test Driven Development, Javascript, React, Redux, MetaProgramming, Big O
* Led daily technical review sessions with instructional team on the curriculum content
* Advised students on Full Stack Projects by assisting in engineering decisions and design as well as solidify programming concepts and
the process of debugging

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped high school students build portfolios that showcase programming skills learned during a fellowship program.
